talent.summary: Nicolás Velasco is co-founding a stealth company in social commerce, previously Co-founder at Veris Agri.
Jack Graham joined Toreo Motion as Co-founder, moving from Celeo Stack.
Gabriel Nogueira joined Paxix Games as Co-founder, moving from Piedraora Credit.
Mateo Ribera co-founded Silly Andina (Vertical SaaS for SMBs) after Co-founder at Umbrella Logistics.
Esteban Ribera joined Cora Neural as VP Engineering, moving from Lialy Energy.
Isabella Cuéllar joined Helify Ruta as Engineering Manager, moving from Mercantil Pagos.
Pablo Suárez is co-founding a stealth company in precision agriculture, previously Co-founder at Silo Ledger.
Jack Spencer co-founded Ostex Mercado (Buy Now Pay Later) after Head of Sales at Silera Academy.
Ignacio Aguilar was promoted to Co-founder at Quanar Ledger.
James Wallace left Nexia Ledger and is exploring what's next.
Larissa Duarte departed Dorix Agents after 5 years.
Lucía Toledo is co-founding a stealth company in construction management software, previously CFO at Nubana Mercado.
